text: For a linear homogeneous ODE, any linear combination of solutions is again a solution (the superposition principle).
explanation: Linearity and homogeneity make the solution set a vector space, so c1*y1 + c2*y2 solves the equation whenever y1 and y2 do. Superposition fails for nonlinear equations and does not apply to the particular solution of a nonhomogeneous equation.
